overview_description.description:
ChatGPT-powered Chrome extension for instant, personalized LinkedIn messages.

Cut through the noise. Say goodbye to boring & generic message templates. Let CoffeeAI do the heavy lifting so you don’t spend 10 minutes personalizing your messages. Get to sending personalized messages in two minutes, just download the chrome extension below!
